adjudication.rationale: In parseRefreshTokenResponse.ts, if the parsed token response lacks refresh_token it mutates the parsed data to set `refresh_token = "refresh_token"` (lines ~23-27). In office365calendar/lib/CalendarService.ts the returned safeParse result is used to spread `tokenResponse.data` into `o365AuthCredentials` (`{ ...o365AuthCredentials, ...(tokenResponse.success && tokenResponse.data) }`), which will overwrite the existing real refresh token with the literal string when credential sharing mode uses the minimum schema (which does not require refresh_token). That mutated credential object is then persisted via `prisma.credential.update(... data: { key: o365AuthCredentials })`, causing refresh token loss/corruption.
